zh: 我进门时打开了灯。
old_en: I turned on the light when I walked into the room.
new_en: I turned on the light when I entered the room.

zh: 妈妈叮嘱我把空调关上。
old_en: Mom told me to turn off the air conditioner.
new_en: Mom told me to turn off the air conditioner.

zh: 爸爸让我关掉台灯。
old_en: Dad asked me to turn off the bedside lamp.
new_en: Dad asked me to turn off the bedside lamp.

zh: 坐下后我打开了电脑准备工作。
old_en: After sitting down, I turned on the computer to prepare for work.
new_en: After sitting down, I turned on the computer to get ready for work.

zh: 同事叫我打开电脑看邮件。
old_en: A colleague told me to turn on the computer to check my emails.
new_en: A colleague told me to turn on the computer to check my emails.

zh: 手机没电了，我打开充电宝给手机充电。
old_en: My phone was out of battery, so I turned on the power bank to charge it.
new_en: My phone was out of battery, so I used the power bank to charge it.

zh: 洗澡前我打开了热水器。
old_en: I turned on the water heater before taking a shower.
new_en: I turned on the water heater before taking a shower.

zh: 天气太冷，我把暖气打开了。
old_en: It was too cold, so I turned on the heating.
new_en: It was too cold, so I turned on the heater.

zh: 客人来了，我把暖气打开了。
old_en: The guests arrived, so I turned on the heating.
new_en: The guests arrived, so I turned on the heating.

zh: 电视太吵，我把电视关掉了。
old_en: The TV was too loud, so I turned it off.
new_en: The TV was too loud, so I turned it off.

zh: 朋友来了，我把电视关掉了。
old_en: I turned off the TV when my friend came over.
new_en: My friend came over, so I turned off the TV.

zh: 打开电脑后，我开始写报告。
old_en: After turning on the computer, I started writing the report.
new_en: After turning on the computer, I started writing the report.

zh: 做完饭我把厨房的灯关掉了。
old_en: After cooking, I turned off the kitchen light.
new_en: After cooking, I turned off the kitchen light.

zh: 我进门时关掉了厨房的灯。
old_en: I turned off the kitchen light when I entered.
new_en: I turned off the kitchen light when I entered.

zh: 开会前我关掉了手机铃声。
old_en: I turned off the phone's ringtone before the meeting.
new_en: Before the meeting, I turned off my phone's ringtone.

zh: 他开会前关掉了电脑。
old_en: He turned off his computer before the meeting.
new_en: He turned off his computer before the meeting.

zh: 睡前我关掉了电视和灯。
old_en: Before bed, I turned off the TV and the light.
new_en: Before bed, I turned off the TV and the light.

zh: 出门前我把空调关掉了。
old_en: Before leaving home, I turned off the air conditioner.
new_en: Before leaving, I turned off the air conditioner.

zh: 早上起来我打开了电视看新闻。
old_en: This morning, I turned on the TV to watch the news.
new_en: This morning, I turned on the TV to watch the news.

zh: 空调开了一整天，出门前我关掉了。
old_en: I turned off the air conditioner after I came home from work.
new_en: The air conditioner was on all day, so I turned it off before leaving.
